workspace.contacts: Sidebar item + page title for the contact list. Noun, plural, 1 word. Narrow sidebar — must fit.
workspace.pipeline: Sidebar item + page title for the sales pipeline (kanban board of leads). Glossary: stays 'pipeline' in Polish.
workspace.boards: Sidebar item + page title for work boards (projects/tasks kanban). Noun, plural. Glossary: boards → Boards (product name stays English).
workspace.forms: Sidebar item + page title for web forms embedded on the customer's own site. Noun, plural.
settings.general: Settings sub-nav item: appearance, language, password, account. Noun, 1 word.
settings.members: Settings sub-nav item: the people who can log into this CRM. Glossary: member → użytkownik.
settings.roles: Settings sub-nav item: permission roles. Noun, plural.
settings.integrations: Settings sub-nav item listing installed plugins. Glossary: plugin → wtyczka. Plural.
settings.mail: Settings sub-nav item for the company mailbox (IMAP+SMTP) configuration. 1 word.
workspace.mail: Sidebar item + page title for the shared company inbox (email threads). 1 word. Polish: 'Poczta'.
quickCreate.contact: Entry in the '+ New' menu — creates a contact. Imperative-ish short phrase, ≤3 words.
quickCreate.lead: Entry in the '+ New' menu — creates a pipeline lead. Glossary: lead stays 'lead' and inflects.
quickCreate.form: Entry in the '+ New' menu — creates a form. ≤3 words.
commandGroup.navigate: Command palette group heading over destinations you can jump to. Uppercase-styled by CSS, so give sentence case. 1 word.
commandGroup.plugins: Command palette group heading over enabled plugin pages. 1 word, plural.
commandGroup.create: Command palette group heading over create actions. 1 word.
commandGroup.contacts: Command palette group heading over contact search hits. 1 word, plural. Glossary: contacts → kontakty.
